in_marathi.name: Dhanyavad
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanyavad हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name of gratitude and respect, derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhanya', which means 'grateful'. In Hindu tradition, the name Dhanyavad is given to a boy as a mark of respect and gratitude towards the deity, elders, or ancestors.
